in_marathi.name: Harshita
in_marathi.long_meaning: Harshita हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Harshita is a name derived from the Sanskrit language, which means 'radiant' or 'shining'. It is a popular name in Hindu tradition and is considered auspicious for a girl child. Harshita is associated with the goddess Lakshmi, the deity of wealth and prosperity.
